_comment: ZEITSPRUNG PHASE 1.5 - INTERACTIVE MONUMENT ROUTE SYSTEM. Route-level data, separate from any single monument's own monuments/<id>/ config folder. Schema intentionally mirrors the existing 3D-museum field-suffix i18n convention (title_de/title_en/title_es etc, see js/monument-3d/i18n-adapter-3d.js) so this file can be resolved with the same resolveI18nField() helper, no parallel resolver. stops[].layoutPosition is an ILLUSTRATIVE SCHEMATIC 2D drawing coordinate (SVG viewBox 0-1000 units) used only to lay out the on-screen route illustration - it is NOT a geographic coordinate and carries no claim of street-level or real-world positional accuracy. Real geographic coordinates and street-level routing (stops[].coordinates, routePoints, streetSegments, cameraPath) are reserved for later and left null/empty until validated geodata is ingested and approved - per Accuracy Rules, nothing here should be read as confirmed geography.

subtitle.de: Fünf Orte, ein gemeinsamer Weg durch die Geschichte Regensburgs.
subtitle.en: Five places, one shared path through Regensburg's history.
subtitle.es: Cinco lugares, un mismo camino por la historia de Regensburg.

reserved._comment_reserved: The following fields are explicitly RESERVED FOR LATER and intentionally left empty. They must stay empty/null until real, validated geodata or approved editorial content exists - never fabricated to fill the schema.
